ei.title: The Changing Face of K-Pop Fandom
ei.subject: 영어2

fullPassage: In the past, being a fan of a Korean pop idol typically meant waving colored balloons at concerts and sending gifts. Most fans, often teenagers, admired their idols from a distance. However, over the past three decades, the K-pop fandom culture has evolved dramatically with the development of digital technology. Today, fans actively engage themselves in communication with their idols through social media platforms. They can provide feedback and suggestions, which can have a beneficial influence on their idols. When they see some positive changes in their idols, they feel rewarded for their contribution. In other words, fans have changed from consumers to active participants in the K-pop phenomenon. In addition to this change in their attitudes and roles, today’s fans express their affection in different ways. Instead of showering their idols with material gifts, they organize fundraising and volunteer activities in the name of their idols. For example, fans of a popular idol group have raised funds to support children’s charities. Fans’ efforts not only promote good images of their idols but also foster the value of sharing. This change in fandom culture shows how fans’ interaction with K-pop idols has become more dynamic and meaningful. The new culture brings fans closer to their idols and provides a more inclusive and rewarding experience for them.

questions.passage: Most fans, often teenagers, (A)[admired / ignored] their idols from a distance. However, over the past three decades, the K-pop fandom culture has evolved dramatically with the development of digital technology. Today, fans actively engage themselves in communication with their idols through social media platforms. They can provide feedback and suggestions, which can have a (B)[beneficial / harmful] influence on their idols. When they see some (C)[positive / negative] changes in their idols, they feel rewarded for their contribution.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 멀리서 동경함 (B) 이로운 영향 (C) 긍정적 변화
det.analysis:
① admired-beneficial-positive: 원문 일치. 과거 팬은 아이돌을 멀리서 '동경했고(admired)', 팬의 피드백은 '이로운(beneficial)' 영향을 주며, 팬은 아이돌의 '긍정적(positive)' 변화를 본다 ←정답
② ignored(무시하다): 팬이 아이돌을 동경했다가 원문이라 반대 ←오답
③ harmful(해로운): 피드백이 이로운 영향을 준다가 원문이라 반대 ←오답
④ negative(부정적): 긍정적 변화를 본다가 원문이라 반대 ←오답

questions.passage: In other words, fans have changed from consumers to (A)[active / passive] participants in the K-pop phenomenon. In addition to this change in their attitudes and roles, today’s fans express their affection in different ways. Instead of showering their idols with material gifts, they organize fundraising and volunteer activities in the name of their idols. For example, fans of a popular idol group have raised funds to support children’s charities. Fans’ efforts not only (B)[promote / damage] good images of their idols but also foster the value of sharing. This change in fandom culture shows how fans’ interaction with K-pop idols has become more (C)[dynamic / static] and meaningful.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 능동적 참여자 (B) 좋은 이미지를 홍보 (C) 더 역동적
det.analysis:
① passive(수동적): 팬이 소비자에서 '능동적(active)' 참여자가 되었다가 원문이라 반대 ←오답
② active-promote-dynamic: 세 자리 모두 원문 일치. 팬은 '능동적(active)' 참여자이고, 노력이 좋은 이미지를 '홍보하며(promote)', 상호작용이 더 '역동적(dynamic)'이 되었다 ←정답
③ damage(손상시키다): 노력이 좋은 이미지를 홍보한다가 원문이라 반대 ←오답
④ static(정적인): 상호작용이 더 역동적이 되었다가 원문이라 반대 ←오답

questions.passage: In addition to this change in their attitudes and roles, today’s fans express their (A)[affection / hostility] in different ways. Instead of showering their idols with material gifts, they organize fundraising and volunteer activities in the name of their idols. For example, fans of a popular idol group have raised funds to (B)[support / oppose] children’s charities. Fans’ efforts not only promote good images of their idols but also foster the value of sharing. This change in fandom culture shows how fans’ interaction with K-pop idols has become more dynamic and meaningful. The new culture brings fans closer to their idols and provides a more (C)[inclusive / exclusive] and rewarding experience for them.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 애정을 표현 (B) 자선단체를 후원 (C) 더 포용적인 경험
det.analysis:
① hostility(적대감): 팬이 '애정(affection)'을 표현한다가 원문이라 반대 ←오답
② oppose(반대하다): 모금으로 자선단체를 '후원한다(support)'가 원문이라 반대 ←오답
③ affection-support-inclusive: 세 자리 모두 원문 일치. 팬은 '애정(affection)'을 표현하고, 아동 자선단체를 '후원하며(support)', 새 문화는 더 '포용적(inclusive)' 경험을 준다 ←정답
④ exclusive(배타적인): 새 문화가 더 포용적 경험을 준다가 원문이라 반대 ←오답

questions.passage: Most fans, often teenagers, admired their idols from a ①<u>distance</u>.  However, over the past three decades, the K-pop fandom culture has ②<u>declined</u> dramatically with the development of digital technology.  Today, fans actively engage themselves in ③<u>communication</u> with their idols through social media platforms.  They can provide feedback and suggestions, which can have a beneficial influence on their idols.  When they see some positive changes in their idols, they feel rewarded for their ④<u>contribution</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② declined → evolved: 팬덤 문화는 쇠퇴한 게 아니라 극적으로 '발전했다'
det.analysis:
✅ ① distance: 과거 팬들이 아이돌을 '멀리서(from a distance)' 동경했다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ② declined(쇠퇴했다) → evolved(발전했다): 'K-pop 팬덤 문화가 지난 30년간 극적으로 발전했다'가 원문. 디지털 기술과 함께 발전했으므로 쇠퇴는 정반대 ←정답
✅ ③ communication: 팬들이 아이돌과의 '소통(communication)'에 참여한다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ④ contribution: 팬이 자신의 '기여(contribution)'에 보람을 느낀다는 문맥에 적절

questions.passage: In other words, fans have changed from consumers to active ①<u>participants</u> in the K-pop phenomenon.  In addition to this change in their attitudes and roles, today’s fans express their affection in different ways.  Instead of showering their idols with material gifts, they ②<u>organize</u> fundraising and volunteer activities in the name of their idols.  For example, fans of a popular idol group have raised funds to support children’s charities.  Fans’ efforts not only promote good images of their idols but also ③<u>hinder</u> the value of sharing.  This change in fandom culture shows how fans’ ④<u>interaction</u> with K-pop idols has become more dynamic and meaningful.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ hinder → foster: 팬의 노력은 나눔의 가치를 방해하는 게 아니라 '길러 준다'
det.analysis:
✅ ① participants: 팬이 소비자에서 능동적 '참여자(participants)'로 바뀌었다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② organize: 팬들이 모금·봉사 활동을 '조직한다(organize)'는 문맥에 적절
❌ ③ hinder(방해하다) → foster(기르다): '좋은 이미지를 홍보할 뿐 아니라 나눔의 가치를 길러 준다'가 원문. 방해는 정반대 ←정답
✅ ④ interaction: 팬과 아이돌의 '상호작용(interaction)'이 역동적이 되었다는 문맥에 적절

questions.passage: When they see some positive changes in their idols, they feel ①<u>punished</u> for their contribution.  In other words, fans have changed from ②<u>consumers</u> to active participants in the K-pop phenomenon.  In addition to this change in their attitudes and roles, today’s fans express their affection in different ways.  Instead of showering their idols with ③<u>material</u> gifts, they organize fundraising and volunteer activities in the name of their idols.  For example, fans of a popular idol group have raised funds to support children’s ④<u>charities</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① punished → rewarded: 긍정적 변화를 보면 팬은 벌 받는 게 아니라 '보람을 느낀다'
det.analysis:
❌ ① punished(벌 받는) → rewarded(보람을 느끼는): '아이돌의 긍정적 변화를 볼 때 자신의 기여에 보람을 느낀다'가 원문. 벌은 정반대 ←정답
✅ ② consumers: 팬이 '소비자(consumers)'에서 능동적 참여자로 바뀌었다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ material: '물질적(material) 선물'을 퍼붓는 대신이라는 문맥에 적절
✅ ④ charities: 팬들이 아동 '자선단체(charities)'를 후원한다는 문맥에 적절

questions.passage: Most fans, often teenagers, admired their idols from a distance.  However, over the past three decades, the K-pop fandom culture has evolved dramatically with the development of digital technology.  Today, fans actively engage themselves in communication with their idols through social media platforms.  They can provide feedback and suggestions, which can have a beneficial __________ on their idols.  When they see some positive changes in their idols, they feel rewarded for their contribution.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 팬의 피드백이 아이돌에게 미치는 이로운 '영향(influence)'
det.analysis:
① silence(침묵): '이로운 침묵'은 어색해 부적절 ←오답
② burden(부담): 이롭다는 것과 모순 ←오답
③ delay(지연): 문맥과 무관 ←오답
④ influence: 원문 'which can have a beneficial influence on their idols'. 팬의 피드백이 아이돌에게 주는 이로운 '영향' ←정답

questions.passage: In other words, fans have changed from consumers to active participants in the K-pop phenomenon.  In addition to this change in their attitudes and roles, today’s fans express their affection in different ways.  Instead of showering their idols with material gifts, they organize fundraising and volunteer activities in the name of their idols.  For example, fans of a popular idol group have raised funds to support children’s charities.  Fans’ efforts not only promote good images of their idols but also foster the __________ of sharing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 팬의 노력이 길러 주는 나눔의 '가치(value)'
det.analysis:
① value: 원문 'foster the value of sharing'. 팬의 노력이 나눔의 '가치'를 길러 준다 ←정답
② price(가격): 나눔에 가격을 매기는 것은 부적절 ←오답
③ danger(위험): 문맥과 반대 ←오답
④ absence(부재): 문맥과 무관 ←오답
det.tip: the value of sharing = 나눔의 가치

questions.passage: Most fans, often teenagers, admired their idols from a distance.  However, over the past three decades, the K-pop fandom culture has evolved dramatically with the development of digital __________.  Today, fans actively engage themselves in communication with their idols through social media platforms.  They can provide feedback and suggestions, which can have a beneficial influence on their idols.  When they see some positive changes in their idols, they feel rewarded for their contribution.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 팬덤 문화를 바꾼 디지털 '기술(technology)'
det.analysis:
① silence(침묵): 문맥과 무관 ←오답
② technology: 원문 'evolved dramatically with the development of digital technology'. 팬덤 문화를 발전시킨 디지털 '기술' ←정답
③ weather(날씨): 문맥과 무관 ←오답
④ distance(거리): 문맥과 무관 ←오답

questions.passage: In the past, being a fan of a Korean pop idol typically meant waving colored balloons at concerts and sending gifts.  Most fans, often teenagers, admired their idols from a distance.  However, over the past three decades, the K-pop fandom culture has evolved <u>dramatically</u> with the development of digital technology.  Today, fans actively engage themselves in communication with their idols through social media platforms.  They can provide feedback and suggestions, which can have a beneficial influence on their idols.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>dramatically</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: dramatically = 극적으로, 급격히 (유의어: drastically)
det.analysis:
① slightly(약간): 급격함과 반대 ←오답
② gradually(점진적으로): 급격함과 반대 ←오답
③ rarely(드물게): 빈도의 문제라 무관 ←오답
④ drastically: '급격하게'로 dramatically와 유의어 ←정답

questions.passage: Most fans, often teenagers, admired their idols from a distance.  However, over the past three decades, the K-pop fandom culture has evolved dramatically with the development of digital technology.  Today, fans actively <u>engage</u> themselves in communication with their idols through social media platforms.  They can provide feedback and suggestions, which can have a beneficial influence on their idols.  When they see some positive changes in their idols, they feel rewarded for their contribution.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>engage</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: engage (oneself) = 참여시키다, 몰두하다 (유의어: involve)
det.analysis:
① involve: 'engage themselves in communication'은 스스로를 소통에 '참여시키다'라 involve와 유의어 ←정답
② withdraw(물러나다): 반대 의미 ←오답
③ ignore(무시하다): 반대·무관 ←오답
④ reject(거부하다): 무관 ←오답

questions.passage: In other words, fans have changed from consumers to active participants in the K-pop phenomenon.  In addition to this change in their attitudes and roles, today’s fans express their affection in different ways.  Instead of showering their idols with material gifts, they organize fundraising and volunteer activities in the name of their idols.  For example, fans of a popular idol group have raised funds to support children’s charities.  Fans’ <u>efforts</u> not only promote good images of their idols but also foster the value of sharing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>efforts</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: efforts = 노력 (유의어: attempts)
det.analysis:
① failures(실패): 반대 의미 ←오답
② doubts(의심): 무관 ←오답
③ attempts: 팬들이 기울이는 '노력'이라 efforts와 유의어 ←정답
④ rewards(보상): 노력의 결과일 뿐 같은 뜻이 아님 ←오답

questions.passage: Instead of showering their idols with material gifts, they organize fundraising and volunteer activities in the name of their idols.  For example, fans of a popular idol group have raised funds to support children’s charities.  Fans’ efforts not only promote good images of their idols but also foster the value of sharing.  This change in fandom culture shows how fans’ interaction with K-pop idols has become more dynamic and meaningful.  The new culture brings fans <u>closer</u> to their idols and provides a more inclusive and rewarding experience for them.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>closer</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: closer = 더 가까운. 반의어: distant(먼)
det.analysis:
① nearer(더 가까운): closer와 유의어라 반대가 아님 ←오답
② warmer(더 따뜻한): 의미축이 달라 반대가 아님 ←오답
③ stronger(더 강한): 의미축이 달라 반대가 아님 ←오답
④ distant: '먼'으로 closer(가까운)와 정반대 ←정답

questions.passage: In addition to this change in their attitudes and roles, today’s fans express their affection in different ways.  Instead of showering their idols with material gifts, they organize fundraising and volunteer activities in the name of their idols.  For example, fans of a popular idol group have raised funds to support children’s charities.  Fans’ efforts not only promote good images of their idols but also foster the value of sharing.  This change in fandom culture shows how fans’ interaction with K-pop idols has become more dynamic and <u>meaningful</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>meaningful</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: meaningful = 의미 있는. 반의어: trivial(사소한)
det.analysis:
① significant(중요한): meaningful과 유의어라 반대가 아님 ←오답
② trivial: '사소한'으로 meaningful(의미 있는)과 정반대 ←정답
③ frequent(잦은): 빈도의 문제라 반대가 아님 ←오답
④ lengthy(긴): 길이의 문제라 반대가 아님 ←오답

questions.passage:
(A) Fans' efforts foster the <u>value</u> of sharing among people.

(B) K-pop idols greatly <u>value</u> the honest feedback that their fans give them.
questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 value의 (A)와 (B) 문맥에서의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: value: (A) 가치 (명사) (B) 소중히 여기다 (동사)
det.analysis:
① (A)소중히 여기다-(B)가치: 두 자리의 품사가 뒤바뀜 ←오답
② 둘 다 가치: (B) idols가 value the feedback은 동사 '소중히 여기다'라 불일치 ←오답
③ (A)가치-(B)소중히 여기다: (A) the value of sharing = 나눔의 '가치'(명사), (B) idols value the feedback = 피드백을 '소중히 여긴다'(동사) ←정답
④ 둘 다 소중히 여기다: (A) the value of는 명사 '가치'라 불일치 ←오답
det.tip: the value of (가치, 명사) vs value something (소중히 여기다, 동사)

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"a fact or event in nature or society, especially a remarkable one that people notice or study"

det.korean: 자연·사회에서 관찰되는 주목할 만한 사실이나 사건 = phenomenon(현상)
det.analysis:
① phenomenon: '사람들이 주목하거나 연구하는 주목할 만한 사실이나 사건, 현상'이라는 정의와 일치 ←정답
② tradition(전통): 대대로 전해지는 관습이라 정의와 무관 ←오답
③ coincidence(우연): 우연의 일치라 정의와 무관 ←오답
④ routine(일상): 반복되는 일과라 정의와 무관 ←오답

questions.passage: However, over the past three decades, the K-pop fandom culture has evolved dramatically with the __________ (develop) of digital technology. Today, fans actively engage themselves in communication with their idols through social media platforms.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: development: 'the ~ of' 구조의 명사 자리
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'with the ___ of digital technology'에서 정관사 the와 전치사 of 사이는 명사 자리다. 동사 develop(발전하다·개발하다)의 명사형은 development(발전)이다. 앞의 evolved(발전했다)가 의미 단서다.

questions.passage: Fans’ efforts not only promote good images of their idols but also foster the value of sharing. This change in fandom culture shows how fans’ __________ (interact) with K-pop idols has become more dynamic and meaningful.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: interaction: 소유격 fans'의 꾸밈을 받는 주어 명사 자리
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'how fans' ___ with K-pop idols has become'에서 소유격 fans' 뒤, 동사 has become의 주어가 필요하므로 명사 자리다. 동사 interact(상호작용하다)의 명사형은 interaction(상호작용)이다.

questions.passage: In other words, fans have changed from consumers to active participants in the K-pop phenomenon.  In addition to this change in their attitudes and roles, today’s fans express their affection in __________.  Instead of showering their idols with material gifts, they organize fundraising and volunteer activities in the name of their idols.  For example, fans of a popular idol group have raised funds to support children’s charities.  Fans’ efforts not only promote good images of their idols but also foster the value of sharing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 예전과 달라진 방식 = different ways, 태도·역할 변화에 더해
det.analysis:
① the same old way(예전과 똑같은 방식): 변화(change)를 강조하는 흐름과 반대 ←오답
② secret code words(비밀 암호): 문맥과 무관 ←오답
③ strict competition(치열한 경쟁): 애정 표현과 무관 ←오답
④ different ways: 원문 'express their affection in different ways'. 물질적 선물 대신 모금·봉사로 표현하므로 '다른 방식' ←정답
det.tip: in different ways = 다른 방식으로 (선물 대신 봉사)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 예전 방식인 물질적 선물 = material gifts, 대신 모금·봉사
det.analysis:
① harsh criticism(가혹한 비판): 아이돌에게 퍼붓던 것은 비판이 아니라 선물 ←오답
② material gifts: 원문 'Instead of showering their idols with material gifts'. 예전엔 '물질적 선물'을 퍼부었으나 이제 모금·봉사로 바뀜 ←정답
③ political slogans(정치 구호): 문맥과 무관 ←오답
④ personal secrets(개인적 비밀): 문맥과 무관 ←오답
